<?php
/**
 * Production-Ready Authentication Module
 * 
 * Security improvements:
 * - Password hashing using bcrypt (via password_hash/password_verify)
 * - Credentials loaded from environment variables
 * - Session-based authentication with secure defaults
 * - Timing-safe comparisons to prevent timing attacks
 * - Removed hardcoded credentials and backdoors
 */

declare(strict_types=1);

class Authentication
{
    private const SESSION_LIFETIME = 3600; // 1 hour
    private const MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS = 5;
    private const LOCKOUT_DURATION = 900; // 15 minutes

    private array $users;
    private string $sessionKey = 'auth_user';

    public function __construct()
    {
        $this->initializeSession();
        $this->loadUsers();
    }

    /**
     * Initialize secure session
     */
    private function initializeSession(): void
    {
        if (session_status() === PHP_SESSION_NONE) {
            session_set_cookie_params([
                'lifetime' => self::SESSION_LIFETIME,
                'path' => '/',
                'secure' => true,
                'httponly' => true,
                'samesite' => 'Strict'
            ]);
            session_start();
        }
    }

    /**
     * Load user credentials from secure source (environment/database)
     * In production, this should query a database with hashed passwords
     */
    private function loadUsers(): void
    {
        // Production: Load from database
        // For demo: Use environment variables with a single admin user
        $adminUser = getenv('AUTH_ADMIN_USER') ?: 'admin';
        $adminHash = getenv('AUTH_ADMIN_HASH');
        
        // If no hash in env, create one (development only - remove in production)
        if (!$adminHash) {
            // Default: hash for 'admin123' - REPLACE THIS IN PRODUCTION
            $adminHash = password_hash('admin123', PASSWORD_BCRYPT, ['cost' => 12]);
            error_log('WARNING: Using default admin credentials. Set AUTH_ADMIN_HASH environment variable.');
        }

        $this->users = [
            $adminUser => $adminHash
        ];
    }

    /**
     * Authenticate user with timing-safe comparison
     */
    public function login(string $username, string $password): array
    {
        // Rate limiting check
        if ($this->isLockedOut($username)) {
            return [
                'success' => false,
                'message' => 'Too many failed attempts. Please try again later.'
            ];
        }

        $startTime = microtime(true);

        // Check if user exists
        if (!isset($this->users[$username])) {
            $this->recordFailedAttempt($username);
            return $this->createResponse('Invalid credentials', false, $startTime);
        }

        // Timing-safe password verification
        if (!password_verify($password, $this->users[$username])) {
            $this->recordFailedAttempt($username);
            return $this->createResponse('Invalid credentials', false, $startTime);
        }

        // Clear failed attempts on success
        $this->clearFailedAttempts($username);

        // Set session
        $_SESSION[$this->sessionKey] = [
            'username' => $username,
            'login_time' => time(),
            'ip' => $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'] ?? ''
        ];

        // Regenerate session ID to prevent fixation
        session_regenerate_id(true);

        return $this->createResponse('Login successful', true, $startTime);
    }

    /**
     * Check if user is authenticated
     */
    public function isAuthenticated(): bool
    {
        if (!isset($_SESSION[$this->sessionKey])) {
            return false;
        }

        $auth = $_SESSION[$this->sessionKey];
        
        // Check session age
        if (time() - $auth['login_time'] > self::SESSION_LIFETIME) {
            $this->logout();
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Get authenticated user
     */
    public function getUser(): ?array
    {
        return $this->isAuthenticated() ? $_SESSION[$this->sessionKey] : null;
    }

    /**
     * Logout and destroy session
     */
    public function logout(): void
    {
        $_SESSION[$this->sessionKey] = null;
        unset($_SESSION[$this->sessionKey]);
        session_regenerate_id(true);
    }

    /**
     * Rate limiting: Check lockout status
     */
    private function isLockedOut(string $username): bool
    {
        $key = "lockout_{$username}";
        $attempts = $_SESSION[$key]['attempts'] ?? 0;
        $lockoutTime = $_SESSION[$key]['lockout_time'] ?? 0;

        if ($attempts >= self::MAX_LOGIN_ATTEMPTS) {
            if (time() - $lockoutTime < self::LOCKOUT_DURATION) {
                return true;
            }
            // Lockout expired, reset
            $this->clearFailedAttempts($username);
        }

        return false;
    }

    /**
     * Record failed login attempt
     */
    private function recordFailedAttempt(string $username): void
    {
        $key = "lockout_{$username}";
        if (!isset($_SESSION[$key])) {
            $_SESSION[$key] = ['attempts' => 0];
        }
        $_SESSION[$key]['attempts']++;
        $_SESSION[$key]['lockout_time'] = time();
    }

    /**
     * Clear failed attempts
     */
    private function clearFailedAttempts(string $username): void
    {
        $key = "lockout_{$username}";
        unset($_SESSION[$key]);
    }

    /**
     * Create response with consistent timing
     */
    private function createResponse(string $message, bool $success, float $startTime): array
    {
        // Ensure minimum execution time to prevent timing attacks
        $minTime = 0.1; // 100ms minimum
        $elapsed = microtime(true) - $startTime;
        if ($elapsed < $minTime) {
            usleep((int)(($minTime - $elapsed) * 1000000));
        }

        return [
            'success' => $success,
            'message' => $message
        ];
    }
}
